title: WAV metadata validation
responsibility: Validates supported WAV container/sample structure and calculates audio duration.

inputs.name: wavInfo.bytes
inputs.description: Complete RIFF/WAVE bytes, at least 44 bytes long, with format and nonempty audio chunks.

outputs.name: wavInfo
outputs.description: Duration in seconds from data length divided by the validated byte rate. Accepts PCM with 8/16/24/32-bit samples or 32-bit IEEE float, one to eight channels and sample rates from 4,000 through 384,000 Hz.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid RIFF length, truncated or misaligned chunks, missing format/data, unsupported encoding/channel/rate, inconsistent sample alignment/byte rate and data lengths not divisible by sample alignment.
